families.structuralDistinction: Piecewise constant sign quantization; exposed threshold-negation preserves input magnitude.
Compact triangular support, falling for positive x below one; neither absolute nor ReLU has this support.
Odd cubic dependence; exposed polynomial unary maps have degree at most two.
Nonlinear odd rational saturation; exposed unary maps are piecewise polynomial.

families.expression: select(y - x, x - y, x >= params.first)
families.structuralDistinction: Threshold on x switches the sign of a binary difference; old threshold-negation is unary and distance branches on x-y.
Square root of a sum of squares; exposed mean, distance, min and max use piecewise linear binary maps.
Quadratic dependence on x combined with independent linear dependence on y; old square families are unary.
Odd square-root dependence; exposed unary maps are piecewise polynomial.
Even reciprocal dependence; exposed unary maps are piecewise polynomial.
Cubic transition with constant outer plateaus; exposed clamp has a linear transition.
Periodic sawtooth with negative-input wrap; exposed floor has unbounded staircase behavior.
Scaled shifted staircase with variable grid spacing; exposed floor has fixed integer boundaries.
Sign-invariant binary minimum magnitude; exposed min is signed and exposed absolute is unary.
Even logarithmic dependence; exposed unary maps are piecewise polynomial.
Even exponentially decaying dependence; exposed unary maps are piecewise polynomial.
Binary rational map with magnitude-dependent denominator; exposed multiply is bilinear.
Quadrant-dependent angular map; no exposed map computes angles or a binary transcendental function.
Sign of x and magnitude of independent y; exposed threshold-negation and absolute use one input.
Bounded periodic triangle; no exposed map is periodic.

families.expression: select(0.5 * x * x, params.first * (abs(x) - 0.5 * params.first), abs(x) > params.first)
families.structuralDistinction: Quadratic core and linear tails; exposed squared maps lack linear tails and absolute lacks a quadratic core.
Independent x times a quadratic function of y; exposed multiply has only first degree in each input.

families.expression: select(y, x, x >= params.first && x <= params.second)
families.structuralDistinction: Two-sided interval selects between two independent inputs; exposed mask has one threshold and a zero alternative.

claimBoundary: Design-time scalar-semantics audit, not task qualification or model evidence. Every new map has differing outputs from all 24 frozen maps at tested original/default and probe parameters. Structural distinctions address parameterized family forms. This does not prove generic program inequivalence, external novelty, or independence of shared elementwise ABI/scaffolding. Public/confirmation check fixtures and model outputs are not consulted.
